SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To embody blessed, peaceful death and the bliss of the afterlife for the virtuous; to bring comfort to the dying.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The good death, the gentle passage to eternal rest, blessedness beyond life.

MythicAppearances: Associated with the Isles of the Blessed
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Invoked for peaceful death; honored in funerary rites; associated with virtuous afterlife.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Obscure deity of blessed death; counterpart to painful or violent death; connected to mystery religions.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as gentle, beautiful goddess bringing comfort; associated with peaceful imagery and the blessed dead.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Blessed Macaria, who brings gentle death and peace eternal to the virtuous.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A gentle presence that brings profound peace, washing away all pain and fear

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoked for peaceful passing, comfort in grief, and hope for blessed afterlife.
AIPromptSeeds: The goddess who turns death into blessing for those who lived well.
The gentle guide who brings peace to the dying and rest to the departed.
NarrativeHooks: The good death earned by a virtuous life
Comfort in the face of mortality
